requirements.clause: Retained-data accounting for the private Python working directory: logical file length and allocated bytes each have a separate inclusive 64 MiB (67,108,864 byte) ceiling and are never summed. Missing or invalid accounting fails closed. Existing per-file, entry, depth, type, link and cancellation bounds are kept. Accepted retained-state accounting only, not a transient hard filesystem quota.
